statement: The United States or Israel will conduct a publicly confirmed military strike on Iranian oil, gas, or petrochemical infrastructure between 2026-08-08 and 2026-08-31.
resolution: Resolved from defense.gov news releases and idf.il statements on 2026-08-31. Yes if any release in the window confirms a US or Israeli strike on Iranian oil, gas, or petrochemical infrastructure.

statement: Russia and Ukraine will sign or jointly announce a ceasefire or peace agreement intended to end large-scale hostilities, effective on or before 2026-12-31.
resolution: Resolved from kremlin.ru and president.gov.ua official statements on 2026-12-31. Yes if both confirm a signed or jointly announced ceasefire or peace agreement ending large-scale hostilities.

statement: The Federal Reserve will cut the federal funds rate at the conclusion of its September 15-16, 2026 FOMC meeting.
resolution: Resolved from the FOMC statement published on federalreserve.gov on 2026-09-16. Yes if the announced federal funds rate target range is lower than the range set after the July 2026 meeting.

statement: WTI crude oil front-month futures will settle above 95.00 USD per barrel on at least one trading day between 2026-08-08 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: Resolved from the CME official NYMEX WTI front-month settlement series read on 2026-09-30. Yes if any settlement in the window is above 95.00.

statement: CISA, EPA, or FBI will issue an advisory, or Reuters or AP will report, that a cyberattack disrupted operational technology at a US water or wastewater utility, between 2026-08-08 and 2026-10-31.
resolution: Resolved from the CISA cybersecurity advisories index on 2026-10-31. Yes if any advisory published in the window names a US water or wastewater utility with disrupted operations.

statement: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, or xAI will disclose a new case, beyond incidents already public as of 2026-08-01, of one of its models autonomously breaching third-party systems, between 2026-08-08 and 2026-10-31.
resolution: Resolved from openai.com, anthropic.com, deepmind.google, and x.ai safety disclosures, cross-checked against Reuters and AP, on 2026-10-31. Yes if any confirms a new case, beyond incidents public by 2026-08-01, of autonomous third-party system breach.

statement: A named individual will publicly declare candidacy to challenge Gianni Infantino for the FIFA presidency in the 2027 election, between 2026-08-08 and 2026-11-30.
resolution: Resolved from fifa.com media releases and Reuters or AP coverage on 2026-11-30. Yes if a named individual is confirmed to have publicly declared candidacy against Infantino for the FIFA presidency.

statement: The Department of Justice will publicly release the Epstein-related documents subject to the New Mexico deadline noted in reporting as of 2026-08-01, on or before 2026-09-25.
resolution: Resolved from justice.gov releases and the docket of the underlying New Mexico court matter on 2026-09-25. Yes if DOJ has publicly released the documents subject to that deadline.

statement: A magnitude 4.0 or greater earthquake will strike the Campi Flegrei or greater Naples area of Italy, between 2026-08-08 and 2026-12-15.
resolution: Resolved from the INGV ISIDe event query, radius 20 km on 40.827N 14.139E, minmagnitude 4.0, starttime 2026-08-08, endtime 2026-12-15. Yes if any event returns.

statement: A commercial oil tanker will be attacked in the Strait of Hormuz or Gulf of Oman, reported by Reuters, AP, or a maritime security firm, between 2026-08-08 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: Resolved from the UKMTO maritime incident report index on 2026-09-30. Yes if any advisory in the window records a commercial oil tanker struck by weapons in the Strait of Hormuz or Gulf of Oman.
